name: lean-project
description: Spend fewer tokens per session: new-project plans with phase gates (loose ideas grilled into decisions first), plans reconstructed for projects already under way, grilling with a glossary for fuzzy changes, lean docs and state files, file maps for reading only the needed lines, model routing for builds, a shared board so parallel agents exchange facts while they run, release-gate reviews (code, performance, security) of the code changed since the last tag, with a full review on major releases and every 5 to 10 minor ones, a session-end handoff draft written for review (no model call), a lessons review that lists stale unpromoted lessons and drops superseded ones, a layer table saying which file answers which question, a sessions command and a session-start line naming the project's newest draft, a command list in its own file so the always-loaded skill stays short, a selftest run in CI on every push, an em-dash hint on written files, a 400-token budget check for the session-start hook, a gain command that logs token use per run, a trivial-task default for the routing line,idempotent board posts, a lessons export to a vault note, command groups split into bin/lib, a reminder to start a fresh session when the context grows, per-project memory linked across projects, a control band with an enforcing rule gate (rule builder included), and on-demand packs (Bricks, WordPress skills, the ui-ux plugin) that stay off until needed (lean-project pack on or off).

context_limit.title: Context limit (tokens)
context_limit.description: Remind me to update the state file and start a new session once the conversation passes this many tokens.

remind_every.title: Remind again every (tokens)
remind_every.description: After the first reminder, remind again each time the conversation grows by this many tokens.

backup_docs.title: Always back up docs before editing
backup_docs.description: On: copy every doc to a dated backup folder before lean-project edits it. Off: back up only when the project is not under version control.

session_drafts_dir.title: Session draft folder
session_drafts_dir.description: Where the end-of-session handoff drafts go, for example a folder in your Obsidian vault. Empty: the plugin data folder.

backup_dir.title: Backup folder
backup_dir.description: Where doc backups go, relative to the project folder.
